name: app-factory
description: Portable AI software-development factory with autonomous context, capability-based execution and privacy-safe local learning.

interface.shortDescription: Recover context, choose executors, verify and learn from safe local outcomes.
interface.longDescription: A portable software-development factory that activates from software intent, recovers repository context and autonomous state, routes each action to capable backends, uses GitHub CI for deterministic proof, and conservatively learns from privacy-safe local execution metadata without making Codex or any vendor mandatory.
defaultPrompt: I want to create a software system. Route it through App Factory automatically.
Resume this software project, use the safest capable backend and continue autonomously.
Use local execution evidence when it is strong enough, without bypassing capability or verification.
